Privacy

Last updated 21 October 2026

This is the privacy notice for zairachrista.com, the portfolio of Zaira Christa Barakat ("I", "me"), based in London, UK. The short version: this site doesn't collect your personal data. The longer version is below.

Who is responsible

I am. Questions about any of this: zcbarakat@gmail.com.

What this site collects

Nothing, by itself. There is no analytics, no advertising or tracking, no contact form, no accounts, and no cookies (see the cookies page). The fonts are hosted on this site, so your browser doesn't make requests to Google or any other font service.

If you email me

If you write to me, I receive your email address and whatever you choose to tell me. I use it only to reply and to keep a record of the conversation. My lawful basis is legitimate interests (answering people who contact me), or taking steps you've asked for if you're asking about work. I keep emails for as long as the conversation or a possible working relationship is live, then delete them when I no longer need them. I don't sell your details or share them with anyone for marketing.

Hosting

Like any website, this one is served by a hosting provider, who may keep standard technical logs (for example your IP address, browser type and the pages requested) for security and to keep the site running. I don't use those logs to identify or track visitors.

Links to other sites

This site links to LinkedIn. LinkedIn has its own privacy policy, and once you click through it's responsible for what it collects.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you can ask me what personal data I hold about you, ask me to correct or delete it, or object to how I use it. Email me and I'll respond. If you're unhappy with how I've handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.

Changes

If the site starts collecting anything (for example analytics or a form), I'll update this page first and say so here.
